sections.title: Father's Day at Bentley Hotel
sections.html:
Father’s Day falls on the third Sunday in June, which in Lanarkshire means the lightest evenings of the year and, with luck, a bit of sun on the conservatory. It is a simpler occasion than most: a good lunch, a drink, and the family round one table.

We serve a Sunday lunch for the day in the restaurant and the conservatory, cooked in our own kitchen in the Scottish and British way, with a choice at each course and the kind of plate a dad hopes for on a Sunday. The bar is the place to start, with a pint or a dram before you sit down. The menu, the sittings and the price are confirmed each season, and we’ll send them over when you ask. If he would rather eat in the evening, tell us and we’ll see what we can do.

Tables range from two to a crowd. Bigger family parties can have the function suite, which seats up to 100 for private dining. Before or after lunch, Strathclyde Country Park is about a mile away for a walk round the loch, and the Dalzell Estate and RSPB Baron’s Haugh are about the same distance for anyone who likes birds and old trees. If someone has travelled, our 18 en-suite rooms are here, parking is free and Motherwell station is about 5 minutes’ walk.

sections.title: The bar, the lunch and the night after

items.title: The bar and the conservatory
items.text: Start with a drink in the bar, then sit down in the conservatory or the restaurant. For a room of your own, our function suite seats up to 100 for private dining.

items.title: The lunch
items.text: A Father's Day Sunday lunch from our own kitchen, Scottish and British cooking with a choice at each course. The menu and price are confirmed each season.

items.title: Stay the night
items.text: Nobody needs to be the driver. Our 18 en-suite rooms are here, with breakfast cooked to order in the morning. Check-in from 2pm, check-out by 11am.

sections.title: Father's Day: what people ask us

items.q: How do we book a table for Father's Day?
items.a: Ring us on 01698 265588 or send an enquiry with your numbers and a rough time. We’ll come back with this year’s menu, sittings and price and hold the table for you.

items.q: Do we need to pay a deposit?
items.a: A deposit may be needed for larger tables. If so, we’ll tell you how much and when it is due, and explain our cancellation terms, when you book.

items.q: Can you cater for dietary requirements and for children?
items.a: Yes. Let us know about allergies, intolerances and vegetarian or vegan guests when you book, so the kitchen can plan ahead. Children are welcome in the restaurant, and we can suggest something smaller for them.

items.q: Is there parking, and can we come by train?
items.a: Parking at the hotel is free, and the train is an easy alternative: Motherwell station is about 5 minutes’ walk and the fastest services reach Glasgow Central in under 20 minutes. Or book a room and let everyone have a drink.

sections.title: Book a table for Father's Day
